title: PriceTrust
tagline: Who hasn't realized too late that they've been overpaying for a product when they later decided to ask elsewhere?  Not all of us have time to go through several sites in search of the best offer; surely we could do it but time is gold and it is not a good idea to waste it
description:
Who hasn't realized too late that they've been overpaying for a product when they later decided to ask elsewhere?

Not all of us have time to go through several sites in search of the best offer; surely we could do it but time is gold and it is not a good idea to waste it

That is why PriceTrust was born, an application that allows users to access all the available prices of the same product at their fingertips. As soon as you enter, we will quickly show you the average price of the product you want to buy in each market so you can make a decision. Plus, we can notify you when the best time to make a purchase is, saving you even more time.

Come with me to see how it works.

The user can enter with traditional digital accounts and enjoy the benefits offered by web3 technology.

Within the application you will find a list of products accompanied by price information from various locations and the average price, built through a decentralized process, allowing you to make better decisions.

Now let's see the technologies used

Chainlink:

We consume the data exposed by each merchant via API and enter it into the block chain using the Sc API, these are stored as variables and then a contract with the philosophy of an aggregator, the reliable value is extracted, which is the average. This value is calculated automatically and repeatedly thanks to the chain link automation service.

Web3auth:

The user uses email accounts to generate a wallet capable of interacting with the aggregator contract providing the value that will be set to receive an alert.

Push:

When the appropriate conditions are met, a flag value performs a push function call that automatically sends a notification to any available communication channel.

Final:

Thanks to the support of the companies gathered here, we hope to obtain the necessary resources to launch the application to the public as soon as possible with the addition of offering payment alternatives tailored to each user and a total redesign of the application, and as you mentioned. , today Today, in addition to showing information about the price of products, it is also possible to configure an element that notifies them when is the best time to buy with a subscription.

After 45 hours, 7 smart contracts and 3500 lines of code generated by Percy, Franklyn and I are as satisfied as we are with the work done and we leave you an open invitation to save time and money by using PriceTrust. 
Thank you very much.
